english: Strange...
french: Bizarre...
russian: Странно...
bulgarian: Strange...

english: Most sorceresses have an affinity for tea, but it's a =latte= for me. Darcy makes it perfect for me. Oh, and she draws something in the foam... that's important.
french: Les sorcières ont souvent un faible pour le thé. Moi, je suis plutôt =café latte=. Celui de Darcy est délicieux. Et, très important, elle fait des dessins dans la mousse.
russian: У большинства чародеек тяга к чаю, но я предпочитаю =латте=. Дарси готовит его идеально. И ещё рисует на пенке разное... А это важно.
bulgarian: Most sorceresses have an affinity for tea, but it's a =latte= for me. Darcy makes it perfect for me. Oh, and she draws something in the foam... that's important.

english: [Ari], look! Darcy drew Dozy in the foam of my latte! So... cute... I-It's too cute to drink...
french: [Ari], regarde ! Darcy a dessiné Dozy dans la mousse de mon café latte ! C'est trop mignon... J'hésite même à le boire.
russian: [Ari], смотри! Дарси нарисовала Дрёму на пенке моего латте! Такой... милый... Я... Я не могу это выпить...
bulgarian: [Ari], look! Darcy drew Dozy in the foam of my latte! So... cute... I-It's too cute to drink...

english: Darcy understands that I'm not picky, I just know what I like, and I like it exactly that way every time.
french: Darcy sait que je ne suis pas difficile. Je sais juste ce que je veux et comment je le veux à chaque fois.
russian: Дарси прекрасно понимает, что я не привередливая. Я просто знаю чего хочу, и хочу я это всегда строго определённым образом.
bulgarian: Darcy understands that I'm not picky, I just know what I like, and I like it exactly that way every time.

english: It was a pleasant surprise to find I have access to a good tailor out here in the country.
french: J'étais agréablement surprise quand j'ai su qu'il y avait un bon tailleur ici, à la campagne.
russian: Было приятно обнаружить, что даже в провинции есть толковый портной.
bulgarian: It was a pleasant surprise to find I have access to a good tailor out here in the country.

english: Louis makes boots that are to die for. The man is indispensable...
french: Louis fabrique des bottes à tomber par terre. C'est un homme précieux...
russian: Луи шьёт такие ботинки — умереть можно. Он просто незаменим...
bulgarian: Louis makes boots that are to die for. The man is indispensable...

english: Louis always respects my choice to raise a hemline and lower a neckline.
french: Louis respecte toujours mon choix de raccourcir le bas et d'échancrer au niveau du décolleté.
russian: Луи всегда уважает моё право поднять подол и опустить вырез.
bulgarian: Louis always respects my choice to raise a hemline and lower a neckline.

english: Poor Louis, exiled from the Capital... I can break a curse without breaking a sweat, but banishment is a whole other story.
french: Pauvre Louis, s'être fait bannir de la capitale... Je peux briser n'importe quelle malédiction, mais l'exil, c'est une autre paire de manches.
russian: Бедный Луи, изгнанный из столицы... Проклятие-то я могу снять без проблем, но с изгнанием всё сложнее.
bulgarian: Poor Louis, exiled from the Capital... I can break a curse without breaking a sweat, but banishment is a whole other story.

english: Merri loves me... she spent months restoring that circular bed, but no one was buying until I came along. There's even an ottoman for Dozy... how could I resist?
french: Merri m'adore. Elle avait passé des mois à restaurer ce lit circulaire, mais il ne trouvait pas preneur avant que j'arrive. Il y a même un pouf pour Dozy... Comment résister ?
russian: Мэрри меня обожает... она несколько месяцев реставрировала ту круглую кровать, но её никто не покупал... пока не пришла я. Даже пуф для Дрёмы был — как устоять?
bulgarian: Merri loves me... she spent months restoring that circular bed, but no one was buying until I came along. There's even an ottoman for Dozy... how could I resist?

english: Merri helped me furnish the Bathhouse very quickly after I arrived... she even managed to find me the perfect chair for my desk.
french: Merri m'a aidée à meubler les bains très rapidement après mon arrivée... Elle a même réussi à dégoter un siège parfaitement assorti au comptoir.
russian: Мэрри помогла обставить купальню сразу после моего приезда... Даже кресло нашла — идеальное для моего стола.
bulgarian: Merri helped me furnish the Bathhouse very quickly after I arrived... she even managed to find me the perfect chair for my desk.

english: Valen called it a "throne" the other day, can you imagine? If I had a throne it wouldn't be so understated!
french: L'autre fois, Valen a dit que c'était un « trône »... Si c'en était un, il ne serait pas aussi sobre !
russian: Вален на днях назвала его «троном», представляешь? Если бы у меня был трон, он точно был бы не таким скромным!
bulgarian: Valen called it a "throne" the other day, can you imagine? If I had a throne it wouldn't be so understated!

english: I have plenty of potion racks, but Merri's keeping an eye out for the vintage kind. Old things hold power, [Ari].
french: J'ai plein d'étagères pour mes potions, mais Merri essaie de m'en trouver d'époque. Les antiquités ont un certain pouvoir, [Ari].
russian: Полок для зелий у меня полно, но Мэрри ищет мне винтажные. Старые вещи хранят силу, [Ari].
bulgarian: I have plenty of potion racks, but Merri's keeping an eye out for the vintage kind. Old things hold power, [Ari].

english: Sometimes I'll see a piece at Merri's that doesn't speak to me... and then she'll show me the purple version... she sure knows how to make a sale.
french: Parfois, je vois un meuble qui ne me plaît pas plus que ça chez Merri... Puis elle me le montre en mauve... Elle connaît son métier.
russian: Иногда приглядываюсь у Мэрри к некоторым вещам, и они меня совсем не трогают... а потом Мэрри показывает фиолетовый вариант... Эта женщина умеет продавать.
bulgarian: Sometimes I'll see a piece at Merri's that doesn't speak to me... and then she'll show me the purple version... she sure knows how to make a sale.

english: Everything Stillwell says is technically true, but does he have to be so dramatic about it? He should be more like me... I've never been dramatic a day in my life.
bulgarian: Everything Stillwell says is technically true, but does he have to be so dramatic about it? He should be more like me... I've never been dramatic a day in my life.

bulgarian: Valen thinks I'm foolish for believing in Stillwell's fortunes, but he's never wrong. Though he is a bit vague, sometimes...

bulgarian: Divine foresight... there are tales of that power in the tomes of the ancient Witch Queens, but I'd never want it myself. I mean, just look how gloomy Stillwell is. No thanks.

bulgarian: "The torturous grind of time's wheel will rot the very grain of your existence"... is Stillwell talking about the sourdough in the back of my cupboard? That would explain the smell...

english: Some people think gorgeous, perfectly styled hair gives you a license to say whatever rude thing you want.
french: Certains s'imaginent qu'une coupe de cheveux impeccable les autorise à être désagréables.
russian: Некоторые люди считают, что шикарные, идеально уложенные волосы дают право говорить любые гадости.
bulgarian: Some people think gorgeous, perfectly styled hair gives you a license to say whatever rude thing you want.

english: Ugh, Taliferro.
french: Ah, Taliferro...
russian: Ух, Талиферро!
bulgarian: Ugh, Taliferro.

english: Maybe I should let Vera style my hair...
french: Je devrais peut-être demander à Vera de me coiffer...
russian: Может, стоит позволить Вере уложить мне волосы...
bulgarian: Maybe I should let Vera style my hair...

english: I've got a potion that turns skin blue, [Ari]. Because you'd suffocate if you drank it. It's a work in progress.
french: J'ai une potion qui teint les gens en bleu, [Ari]. En fait, ils sont bleus parce qu'ils étouffent. Je dois encore travailler dessus.
russian: У меня есть зелье, от которого кожа становится синей, [Ari]. Потому что, если его выпить, начнёшь задыхаться. Я работаю над этим.
bulgarian: I've got a potion that turns skin blue, [Ari]. Because you'd suffocate if you drank it. It's a work in progress.

english: Vera says she has a dye that turns hair blue... hah!
french: Vera dit qu'elle a une coloration qui teint les cheveux en bleu... Ha !
russian: Вера говорит, у неё есть краска, делающая волосы синими... ха!
bulgarian: Vera says she has a dye that turns hair blue... hah!

english: I just want to see what would happen.
french: Juste pour voir ce qu'il se passerait.
russian: Мне просто любопытно, что из этого выйдет.
bulgarian: I just want to see what would happen.

english: Do you think Vera would notice if I infused her hair dye with mana...?
french: Tu crois que Vera s'en apercevrait si je mettais du mana dans ses colorations...?
russian: Как думаешь, Вера заметит, если я подмешаю в её краску ману...?
bulgarian: Do you think Vera would notice if I infused her hair dye with mana...?

english: I can't get my hair dyed here... I prefer to use potions, so there's no telling what color it would come out.
french: Je ne peux pas me teindre les cheveux ici... Je préfère utiliser des potions. Impossible de savoir quelle couleur ça donnerait.
russian: Здесь мне не покраситься... Я предпочитаю зелья. С ними никогда не знаешь, какой цвет получится.
bulgarian: I can't get my hair dyed here... I prefer to use potions, so there's no telling what color it would come out.

english: Those garish colors! The deliberate pattern clashing! And his awful, oversized belt buckles!
french: Ces couleurs chatoyantes ! Ces motifs qui s'entrechoquent ! Et ces immondes boucles de ceinture trop grandes !
russian: Такие крикливые цвета! И нарочно несовпадающие узоры! И эти кошмарно огромные пряжки!
bulgarian: Those garish colors! The deliberate pattern clashing! And his awful, oversized belt buckles!

english: He looks just like a poisonous frog...
french: On dirait un crapaud venimeux...
russian: Он похож на ядовитую лягушку...
bulgarian: He looks just like a poisonous frog...

english: Oh ho ho ho!
french: Oh ho ho ho !
russian: О-хо-хо-хо!
bulgarian: Oh ho ho ho!

english: Much as it pains me to admit, I can't help but respect Wheedle's sense of fashion.
french: Même si ça me désole de l'admettre, j'apprécie les tenues de Wheedle.
russian: Мне больно это признавать, но чувство стиля у Хлюста я уважаю.
bulgarian: Much as it pains me to admit, I can't help but respect Wheedle's sense of fashion.

english: 'Cash is king' my left heel... he doesn't know just how valuable my concoctions are!
french: « De l'argent ou rien », crétin... Il n'a aucune idée de ce que valent mes mixtures !
russian: «Только наличные» — ну да, конечно! Он просто не знает цены моим зельям!
bulgarian: 'Cash is king' my left heel... he doesn't know just how valuable my concoctions are!

english: I tried to trade Wheedle one of my home-brewed tonics for a bottle of his $Snake Oil$, and he turned me down flat!
french: J'ai essayé d'échanger un de mes toniques contre une bouteille d'$huile de couleuvre$ avec Wheedle, mais il a refusé !
russian: Я хотела обменять у Хлюста один мой домашний бальзам на флакон его $змеиного масла$, а он категорически отказался!
bulgarian: I tried to trade Wheedle one of my home-brewed tonics for a bottle of his $Snake Oil$, and he turned me down flat!

english: Who doesn't love something that's a little deep-fried?
french: Et puis, tout est appétissant dès que c'est frit, non ?
russian: Кому может не понравиться прожарка во фритюре?
bulgarian: Who doesn't love something that's a little deep-fried?

english: Obviously I don't need a third-party enhancement, but Wheedle's $Fast Food$ does look enticing, doesn't it?
french: J'ai plutôt le palais fin, mais je dois avouer que l'$encas sur le pouce$ de Wheedle a l'air appétissant.
russian: Меня, конечно, не интересуют чужие ускоряющие эффекты, но $фастфуд$ Хлюста выглядит весьма заманчиво.
bulgarian: Obviously I don't need a third-party enhancement, but Wheedle's $Fast Food$ does look enticing, doesn't it?

english: The very gall of it!
french: Ce n'est même plus de l'audace, là !
russian: Какая беззастенчивая наглость!
bulgarian: The very gall of it!

english: Wheedle tried to sell me a fake potion! Me!
french: Wheedle a essayé de me vendre une fausse potion, à moi !
russian: Хлюст пытался продать мне поддельное зелье! Мне!
bulgarian: Wheedle tried to sell me a fake potion! Me!

english: Maybe I'll just get him both.
french: Je vais peut-être lui prendre les deux.
russian: На всякий случай возьму оба.
bulgarian: Maybe I'll just get him both.

english: Which genre of $Song Crystal$ do you think Dozy would prefer, "experimental jazz" or "thrash metal"?
french: D'après toi, quel $cristal musical$ plairait le plus à Dozy, « Jazz expérimental » ou « Trash metal » ?
russian: Как ты думаешь, какой жанр $поющих кристаллов$ больше понравится Дрёме: «экспериментальный джаз» или «трэш-метал»?
bulgarian: Which genre of $Song Crystal$ do you think Dozy would prefer, "experimental jazz" or "thrash metal"?

english: Maybe someday, my achievements will be worthy of it!
french: Peut-être qu'un jour, je réussirai à m'en montrer digne !
russian: Возможно, однажды мои заслуги будут достойны его!
bulgarian: Maybe someday, my achievements will be worthy of it!

english: Ohoho!
french: Oh ho ho !
russian: Охо-хо!
bulgarian: Ohoho!

english: You've impressed me, [Ari]. The =Ancient Royal Scepter= you turned over is a symbol of the Witch Queen's authority.
french: Tu m'impressionnes, [Ari]. Le =sceptre royal antique= que tu as donné au musée est le symbole de l'autorité de la Reine-sorcière.
russian:
Ты

впечатлили

впечатлилавпечатлилвпечатлило меня, [Ari]. Этот =древний королевский скипетр=, который ты

передали

передалапередалпередало музею, — символ власти королевы-ведьмы.
bulgarian: You've impressed me, [Ari]. The =Ancient Royal Scepter= you turned over is a symbol of the Witch Queen's authority.

english: Don't worry your head about it, if he follows my advice it'll keep that glow for another thousand years.
french: Ne te mets pas martel en tête. S'il suit mes conseils, elle conservera cette lueur pendant encore mille ans.
russian: Не утруждай себя размышлениями: если он последует моему совету, свет сохранится ещё тысячу лет.
bulgarian: Don't worry your head about it, if he follows my advice it'll keep that glow for another thousand years.

english: Errol had me in to consult on the $Ancient Stone Lantern$ you donated.
french: Errol m'a permis d'examiner la $lanterne en pierre antique$ dont tu as fait don.
russian:
Эррол пригласил меня проконсультироваться по поводу $древнего каменного фонаря$, который ты

пожертвовали

пожертвовалапожертвовалпожертвовало.
bulgarian: Errol had me in to consult on the $Ancient Stone Lantern$ you donated.

english: Terithia says I should accept that the world holds mysteries we'll never solve. That's exactly what I don't like!
french: Terithia dit que je devrais accepter le fait qu'il existe au monde des mystères qu'on ne résoudra jamais. C'est précisément ce que je déteste !
russian: Теризия говорит, что надо просто принять, что в мире есть тайны, которые не суждено разгадать. Но именно это мне и не нравится!
bulgarian: Terithia says I should accept that the world holds mysteries we'll never solve. That's exactly what I don't like!

english: That $Dense Water$ at the Museum unsettles me. How can it hold form like that?
french: Cette $eau dense$, au musée, me perturbe. Comment parvient-elle à conserver ainsi sa forme ?
russian: $Загустевшая вода$ в музее меня тревожит. Как она сохраняет форму?
bulgarian: That $Dense Water$ at the Museum unsettles me. How can it hold form like that?

english: Also, that green is really pretty.
french: Et puis ce vert est vraiment très joli.
russian: И цвет у него такой красивый, зелёненький.
bulgarian: Also, that green is really pretty.

english: That $Earth-Infused Stone$ at the Museum... I'm curious about the conditions under which it took on elemental qualities.
french: Cette $pierre de terre$, au musée... Je me demande dans quelles conditions elle a pu acquérir ses propriétés élémentaires.
russian: Тот $камень стихии земли$ в музее... любопытно, как он получил свои элементальные свойства.
bulgarian: That $Earth-Infused Stone$ at the Museum... I'm curious about the conditions under which it took on elemental qualities.

english: That $Essence Blossom$ at the Museum... I wonder why magical energy gathers in something like that. There must be some logic to it.
french: Cet $essensia$, au musée... Je me demande pourquoi l'énergie magique se concentre dans une chose pareille. Il doit y avoir une logique, là-dedans.
russian: Я видела в музее $цветок эссенции$... Интересно, почему в нём скапливается магическая энергия. Должно быть какое-то объяснение.
bulgarian: That $Essence Blossom$ at the Museum... I wonder why magical energy gathers in something like that. There must be some logic to it.

english: I suppose even magic can fossilize, given enough time and pressure.
french: J'imagine qu'avec le temps et une pression suffisante, même la magie peut se fossiliser.
russian: Видимо, много времени и большое давление даже из магии могут сделать камень.
bulgarian: I suppose even magic can fossilize, given enough time and pressure.

english: That $Hardened Essence$ they've got in the Museum's collection... interesting.
french: Cette $essence solidifiée$ qu'ils ont au musée... C'est intéressant.
russian: $Застывшая эссенция$ в музее выглядит... интересно.
bulgarian: That $Hardened Essence$ they've got in the Museum's collection... interesting.

english: I must learn its secrets.
french: Il faut que je trouve son secret.
russian: Я обязана узнать её тайны.
bulgarian: I must learn its secrets.

english: That $Lava Piranha$... the one at the Museum. How do you think it survives in such heat?
french: Ce $piranha de lave$... au musée. Comment fait-il pour résister à une telle chaleur ?
russian: Эта $лавовая пиранья$ в музее... Как, по-твоему, ей удаётся выдерживать такой жар?
bulgarian: That $Lava Piranha$... the one at the Museum. How do you think it survives in such heat?

english: I've never seen anything like that $Mistmoth$ at the Museum. It must be unique to Mistria.
french: Je n'avais jamais rien vu de semblable à cette $phalène de brume$, au musée. Elle ne doit exister qu'à Mistria.
russian: Никогда не видела ничего похожего на $туманницу$ из музея. Видимо, такие обитают только в Мистрии.
bulgarian: I've never seen anything like that $Mistmoth$ at the Museum. It must be unique to Mistria.

english: You must never tell anyone what you see in its reflection. Okay?
french: Tu ne dois jamais dire à quiconque ce que tu vois dans son reflet. D'accord ?
russian: Никому не рассказывай, что ты видишь в отражении, ладно?
bulgarian: You must never tell anyone what you see in its reflection. Okay?

english: That $Misty Black Mirror$ that they've added to the Museum's collection...
french: Ce $miroir obscur de brume$ qui a été ajouté aux collections du musée...
russian: Насчёт $туманного чёрного зеркала$, которое недавно появилось в музее...
bulgarian: That $Misty Black Mirror$ that they've added to the Museum's collection...

english: Isn't it lovely?
french: Je la trouve magnifique !
russian: Симпатично, правда?
bulgarian: Isn't it lovely?

english: The $Red Obsidian$ at the Museum is a red that I can only describe as... sinister.
french: L'$obsidienne rouge$ du musée est d'un rouge... particulièrement sinistre.
russian: У $красного обсидиана$ в музее такой оттенок... Иначе как зловещим не назовёшь.
bulgarian: The $Red Obsidian$ at the Museum is a red that I can only describe as... sinister.

english: Maybe I should hold more rituals that call for incense. Liven things up a bit at the Bathhouse.
french: Je devrais peut-être utiliser davantage l'encens dans mes rituels. Ça égaierait un peu l'ambiance, aux bains.
russian: Может, стоит проводить больше ритуалов с благовониями. Освежить атмосферу купальни.
bulgarian: Maybe I should hold more rituals that call for incense. Liven things up a bit at the Bathhouse.

english: That $Ritual Incense Burner$ at the Museum got me thinking.
french: L'$encensoir rituel$ du musée m'a fait réfléchir.
russian: $Ритуальная горелка$ в музее натолкнула меня на мысль.
bulgarian: That $Ritual Incense Burner$ at the Museum got me thinking.

english: They simply don't make them like that anymore.
french: On n'en fait plus des comme ça, désormais.
russian: Такие вещи уже не делают...
bulgarian: They simply don't make them like that anymore.

english: I felt such a pang of nostalgia looking over the ancient $Ritual Tablet$ in the Museum's collection.
french: Ça m'a rendue vraiment nostalgique d'un coup, de regarder l'antique $tablette rituelle$ dans les collections du musée.
russian: Я почувствовала странную тоску, глядя на древнюю $ритуальную табличку$ в музее.
bulgarian: I felt such a pang of nostalgia looking over the ancient $Ritual Tablet$ in the Museum's collection.

english: What do you suppose it burns for fuel?
french: Quel carburant utilise-t-elle, à ton avis ?
russian: Что она использует в качестве топлива?
bulgarian: What do you suppose it burns for fuel?

english: The $Smoke Moth$ at the Museum...
french: La $phalène fumigène$ du musée...
russian: Как ты думаешь, $дымная бабочка$ в музее...
bulgarian: The $Smoke Moth$ at the Museum...

english: Oh, I adore that $Sunset Moth$ flitting about over at the Museum. Those markings and patterns... they're so eye-catching! So confident!
french: Oh, j'adore cette $phalène du couchant$ qui volette partout, au musée. Ces dessins, ces motifs... Ils sont si voyants ! Quelle assurance !
russian: Ой, я просто без ума от $урании$, которая порхает в музее. Эти отметины и узоры... такие эффектные, что просто завораживают взгляд!
bulgarian: Oh, I adore that $Sunset Moth$ flitting about over at the Museum. Those markings and patterns... they're so eye-catching! So confident!

english: I wonder if I could use it as a reagent.
french: Je me demande si elle pourrait me servir de réactif.
russian: Интересно, можно ли использовать её как реагент.
bulgarian: I wonder if I could use it as a reagent.

english: That $Thorn Vine$ at the Museum...
french: Cette $ronce$ dans le musée...
russian: Насчёт $шипастой лозы$ в музее...
bulgarian: That $Thorn Vine$ at the Museum...

english: All I can say is, don't get it on your clothes. A stain would be the least of your concerns.
french: Je te demande juste de ne jamais en répandre sur tes vêtements. Une malheureuse tache serait alors le cadet de tes soucis.
russian: Всё, что я могу сказать: не допускай, чтобы она попала на одежду. Иначе проблемы будут похуже пятен.
bulgarian: All I can say is, don't get it on your clothes. A stain would be the least of your concerns.

english: That $Void Powder$ in the Museum's collection...
french: Cette $poudre du néant$, dans les collections du musée...
russian: Насчёт $пустотной пыли$, которая хранится в музее...
bulgarian: That $Void Powder$ in the Museum's collection...

english: It's so me!
french: C'est tellement moi !
russian: Вот это мой стиль!
bulgarian: It's so me!

english: [Ari]! Have you seen the $Void Snail$ at the Museum? A black snail that likes to live in total darkness...
french: [Ari] ! Tu as vu l'$escargot du néant$, au musée ? Un escargot noir qui aime vivre dans l'obscurité totale...
russian:
[Ari]! Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело в музее $пустотную улитку$? Совершенно чёрная улитка, обитающая в кромешной тьме...
bulgarian: [Ari]! Have you seen the $Void Snail$ at the Museum? A black snail that likes to live in total darkness...

english: I should let it go, but seeing something so round and pretty, I simply must ponder it.
french: Je devrais arrêter d'y penser, mais quand je vois quelque chose d'aussi joli et rond, je ne peux que me creuser les méninges.
russian: Надо бы отпустить, но... такая округлая и красивая. Хочется в ней разобраться.
bulgarian: I should let it go, but seeing something so round and pretty, I simply must ponder it.

english: The $Water Sphere$ at the Museum is mysterious. None of the obvious magical explanations fit.
french: La $sphère d'eau$, au musée, est très mystérieuse. Aucune des explications magiques évidentes ne semble correspondre.
russian: Эта $сфера воды$ в музее — загадка. Ни одно из очевидных магических объяснений не подходит.
bulgarian: The $Water Sphere$ at the Museum is mysterious. None of the obvious magical explanations fit.

english: Menacing? What's so menacing about an otherworldly, floating void with no discernible purpose or adherence to natural law?
french: Menaçante ? Qu'y a-t-il de menaçant dans un objet flottant surnaturel constitué de vide, qui ne semble avoir aucune raison d'être et ne suit aucune des lois naturelles ?
russian: Ну что такого зловещего в потусторонней парящей пустоте, не подчиняющейся ни одному закону природы?
bulgarian: Menacing? What's so menacing about an otherworldly, floating void with no discernible purpose or adherence to natural law?

english: Valen says the $Weightless Stone$ at the Museum is menacing.
french: Valen trouve que la $pierre sans poids$ du musée est menaçante.
russian: Вален говорит, что $невесомый камень$ из музея какой-то зловещий.
bulgarian: Valen says the $Weightless Stone$ at the Museum is menacing.

english: Good morning [Ari].
french: Bonjour [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning [Ari].

english: The day feels full of potential, doesn't it?
french: Cette journée semble pleine de potentiel, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Сегодня чувствуется большой потенциал, да?
bulgarian: The day feels full of potential, doesn't it?

english: Hmm...
french: Hmm...
russian: Хмм...
bulgarian: Hmm...

english: Do keep me apprised.
french: Tiens-moi au courant.
russian: Не забудь меня известить.
bulgarian: Do keep me apprised.

english: Any interesting plans today?
french: Tu as quelque chose d'intéressant de prévu aujourd'hui ?
russian: У тебя есть на сегодня интересные планы?
bulgarian: Any interesting plans today?

english: I'm glad you stopped by.
french: Ta visite me fait plaisir.
russian:
Рада, что ты

зашли

зашлазашёлзашло.
bulgarian: I'm glad you stopped by.

english: You know what, [Ari]?
french: Tu sais quoi, [Ari] ?
russian: Знаешь что, [Ari]?
bulgarian: You know what, [Ari]?

english: Let me know if you want in.
french: Si tu veux participer, n'hésite pas.
russian: Захочешь поучаствовать — только скажи.
bulgarian: Let me know if you want in.

english: I'm thinking of trying out a new spell later...
french: J'ai l'intention de tester un nouveau sort, tout à l'heure...
russian: Я подумываю скоро испытать новое заклинание...
bulgarian: I'm thinking of trying out a new spell later...

english: Got any new gossip to share?
french: Tu as des potins intéressants à partager ?
russian: Может, у тебя есть новые слухи?
bulgarian: Got any new gossip to share?

english: Another day in Mistria...
french: Une nouvelle journée à Mistria...
russian: Очередной день в Мистрии...
bulgarian: Another day in Mistria...

english: Care to join me, [Ari]?
french: On fait ça ensemble, [Ari] ?
russian: Присоединишься, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Care to join me, [Ari]?

english: Time to relax after a long day...
french: Rien ne vaut un peu de détente après une longue journée...
russian: Пора отдохнуть после долгого дня...
bulgarian: Time to relax after a long day...

english: But since you're here... maybe they can wait.
french: Mais puisque tu es là... ça peut peut-être attendre.
russian: Но раз уж ты тут... дела подождут.
bulgarian: But since you're here... maybe they can wait.

english: I still have a few things to take care of this evening.
french: Je dois encore m'occuper d'un certain nombre de choses, ce soir.
russian: У меня ещё есть немного дел сегодня вечером.
bulgarian: I still have a few things to take care of this evening.

english: Just couldn't resist chatting one last time before bed, huh?
french: Tu n'as pu résister à l'envie de me parler une dernière fois avant d'aller te coucher, hein ?
russian: Захотелось поболтать перед сном?
bulgarian: Just couldn't resist chatting one last time before bed, huh?

english: I don't blame you.
french: Je te comprends.
russian: Я тебя не виню.
bulgarian: I don't blame you.

english: [Ari], good evening.
french: [Ari], bonsoir.
russian: [Ari], добрый вечер.
bulgarian: [Ari], good evening.

english: Good morning [Ari].
french: Bonjour [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
